arguments.sql: SELECT m.mcc AS mcc, c.description AS description, COUNT(*) AS labelled_transactions, SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_transactions, 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.id JOIN mcc_codes c ON m.mcc = c.mcc GROUP BY m.mcc, c.description HAVING SUM(f.is_fraud) >= 50 ORDER BY fraud_rate DESC, m.mcc ASC
arguments.explanation: Computes the fraud rate over labelled transactions for each MCC that has at least 50 fraud-labelled transactions, sorted by fraud rate.
assumptions: Fraud rate is computed over labelled transactions only; unlabelled transactions are excluded.
'Transactions labelled as fraud' means rows where fraud_labels.is_fraud = 1.
MCC is taken from the merchant's mcc (merchants.mcc), since transactions has no mcc column.
